post.description:
201 whenever a row was created — INCLUDING status="rejected".

Carrier rejection is data, not an HTTP error (phase-1-plan DR-7): the channel is async
end to end, so a client that must already handle DLR-driven failure reads one uniform
resource rather than branching on HTTP status.

schema.title: Response Current Org Members Api V1 Orgs Current Members Get

get.description:
The resource the tenancy gate test reads across tenants.

Note there is no ``.where(org_id == ...)`` here. That is deliberate: the session-level
guard injects it. If the guard ever regresses, this endpoint leaks — which is exactly
why the gate test asserts on it.
